question: Should this signed marketplace feed slice be required to enforce sequence/freshness rollback protection and preserve signed profile verification across URL overrides before merge?
rationale: This PR creates a new marketplace-feed trust boundary; automation can identify the bypasses, but maintainer/security intent decides whether they must block this staged slice or can be explicitly accepted as follow-up risk.

options.title: Require Trust Repairs Before Merge
options.body: Block merge until signed refresh rejects stale sequence/freshness updates and feedUrl plus feedProfile cannot drop signed verification.

options.title: Accept Temporary Trust Gap
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge this staged slice with a visible follow-up, but signed-feed consumers would carry rollback and URL-override bypass risk.

options.title: Pause Behind Trust Stack
options.body: Keep this PR open behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98299 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98316 until the predecessor trust contracts settle.

recommendation.title: Require Trust Repairs Before Merge
recommendation.body: Block merge until signed refresh rejects stale sequence/freshness updates and feedUrl plus feedProfile cannot drop signed verification.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and already performed the current trust-boundary review on this exact PR head.
